mapper.select: SELECT profile_id, account_id, patient_id, patient_version, version, sex_code, birth_date, height_cm, timezone, activity_level_code, goal_type_code, updated_at FROM user_profile WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (profile_id, account_id, patient_id, patient_version, version, sex_code, birth_date, height_cm, timezone, activity_level_code, goal_type_code, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{accountId}, #{patientId}, #{patientVersion}, #{version}, #{sexCode}, #{birthDate}, #{heightCm}, #{timezone}, #{activityLevelCode}, #{goalTypeCode}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO profile_snapshot (profile_id, version, snapshot_json, created_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{version}, #{snapshotJson}, #{createdAt})
